examples.ref: 2012, Luís Fernando Veríssimo, “A tática da bolsa”, in Diálogos Impossíveis, Rio de Janeiro: Editora Objetiva, →ISBN, page 119:
examples.english: Jussara fancied a guy and she devised a plan to meet him. Or for him to meet her. A thorough plan, that she described to her friends as if it were a military operation. Instead of conquering an enemy stronghold, Jussara would conquer the guy, who would surrender to her attack. She believed that, in love as in war, boldness was everything.
